system.descricao:
The character has chakra-sucking insects living inside their body, which they use as weapons and support. Each level must be purchased separately, as an evolution of the skill. LEVEL 1
Prerequisite: Handling Animals 1
Benefit: The character will host a number of insects on their body depending on their level in Animal Handling. The insects will not be referred to individually, but rather in groups, and each group of 100 insects will be referred to as 1 kikaichuu. Quantity: The character will have 1 kikaichuu (group of 100 insects) inside their body for each level of Animal Handling. This number is in addition to any other type of insect that the The character possesses. Control: The kikaichuu will be under the character's direct control and knows no betrayal; it will not hesitate to obey any command and can never be commanded by another character or creature. The insects may pass some information to the character, within limits determined by the game master. When a character uses a kikaichuu to perform a jutsu (for example, the Mushi Bunshin no Jutsu), this kikaichuu cannot be used simultaneously for other purposes. Actions: The kikaichuu can only perform any type of action under the character's control. Any command given to the kikaichuu will be... obeyed automatically and will count towards the action limit of character: Release/Collapse: Make one or more kikaichuu enter or exit the The character's body is a free action. Attack: Attacking with 1 or more Kikaichuu is a standard action. Move: Moving one or more kikaichuu to any location is a partial action. The kikaichuu's movement is 15m per action. Lost Insects: If out of combat and not being used in any technique, the kikaichuu can remain a maximum of 100m away from the Aburame. Beyond this distance, it is considered lost and can no longer be used. When a kikaichuu is destroyed or lost, a new one will appear on the character's body within 2 days, through the accelerated reproduction of the remaining insects on the character's body. A kikaichuu left behind will disperse if it remains uncontrolled by the character for 3 days. Vitality and Resistance: Insects are fragile, dying from a single lethal attack, no matter how minimal. Single-target attacks destroy 1 kikaichu, and area attacks destroy all insects in the affected area. Non-lethal damage does not destroy insects. They are also immune to poisons (or any other type of intoxication) and Genjutsu. Attack: You can use up to half of the total number of insects you possess to perform an attack through a Ranged Combat test. This attack does not cause damage to the opponent, but it drains their chakra, in an amount equal to the number of kikaichuu used. You do not spend chakra to attack in this way, and the chakra drained from the victim is completely consumed by the insects. To perform diverse attacks and inflict damage on the opponent, the character must utilize the Kikai Ninpou power. The attack with Kikaichu cannot be defended against by Block (neither regular attacks nor the effects of Kikai Ninpou). The Kikaichuu alone neither suffers nor can perform opportune attacks, but it can be used by you to perform opportune attacks for your Aburame character. The Kikaichuu cannot be used in attacks or maneuvers other than those mentioned in this skill or the Kikai Ninpou. Maneuvers: The Kikaichu alone cannot perform maneuvers such as Sneak Attack or Opportunistic Attack, however it can be used by you when your Aburame character performs these maneuvers. Defense: Whenever your insects are targeted by an attack, you can use the Anticipate reaction to move them and avoid being hit. Chakra below Zero: If the target already has zero points in their natural chakra reserve and suffers a forced drain, they will die if the drained chakra is equal to or greater than half of their natural reserve. Thus, if your natural reserve has 40 chakra points, you will die if you have 20 points drained below zero. Kikaichuu Mastery: If you purchase the Kikaichuu Mastery skill, its benefits will apply to all insect types and also to the Kikai Ninpou power. LEVEL 2
Prerequisite: Handling Animals 10
Benefit: You gain greater control over your insects, receiving the following additional abilities. Notice Genjutsu: If the genjutsu effect allows, the Aburame can observe the behavior of insects to deduce that there is an illusion within themselves or in the environment. This allows them to perform the Notice Genjutsu test using the Handle Animals ski

The character is able to manipulate insects that violently drain chakra and grow absurdly large as they feed. Prerequisites: Handling Animals 12; Kikaichuu.
Benefit: In appearance, kidaichuu more closely resemble beetles, and their rules of use are the same as kikaichuu. However, kidaichuu consume their target's chakra much more violently, increasing in size as they feed on the enemy's energy. Because they are difficult to create, kidaichuu are kept in smaller quantities in the Aburame's body. Restriction: The character cannot possess both the Kidaichuu and Rinkaichuu abilities simultaneously. Quantity: The Aburame can only keep 1 kidaichuu insect on their body for every 3 completed levels of Animal Handling. This number is in addition to any other type of insect the character possesses. Usage: Kidaichuu cannot fly. To use them, you need to directly touch the target (CC test) to place the insects on its body. With a single touch, you can place all the available insects. Each kidaichuu aggressively consumes the victim's chakra, at a rate of 2 points, growing absurdly in size in a very short time. At the end of the turn, its size grows to medium and it attacks the enemy (this first attack does not drain chakra again). From then on, the kidaichuu are considered partner henchmen (see Command Partner, p. 269), with the following parameters: Attack: The insects attack with a bite, which has zero weapon damage. Each attack also drains 2 chakra points from the victim. Kidaichuu's CC tests use the Aburame's DC accuracy. If more than one kidaichuu attacks in the same turn, you must roll a single test for all attacks (the target also makes only one defense). Defense: Insects defend themselves with Dodge. The dodge reaction is calculated using the Aburame's LM level. Attributes: Strength and Agility have a value equal to the Animal Handling level -2. The other attributes have half of this. Skills: Out of combat, use attributes such as accuracy. In combat, insects automatically fail any test. Vitality: equals 2x the Animal Handling level. Chakra: Each insect possesses chakra in its body in an amount equal to that which was drained from its victims. Other parameters are calculated using the normal rules. The character does not consume chakra to attack with the kidaichuu, and the chakra drained from the victim is completely consumed by the insects. Below is an example character sheet for a kidaichuu at NC 12, assuming the Aburame has maximum Animal Handling, maximum DC and LM with a base value of 4, and the skills Mastery and Intuition. If the Aburame always has these precisions at maximum, to update the example sheet simply increase the attribute and precision levels by +1 for each NC.

Use of Insects: Kikai Ninpou techniques utilize 1 kikaichuu per power level. The insects used move to attack the target and then return to the user, all as a free action. Chakra Drainage: Kikai Ninpou techniques drain 1 chakra point per level of power used when in contact with targets. Only effects that cost chakra are capable of draining the target's chakra. If the effect has split attacks, the amount of chakra drained is divided equally. Effects that cause damage per turn also drain chakra per turn, but the drain is halved. Range: Medium (10m + 2m per Animal Handling level). The character can only manipulate or create their element up to the maximum range of their power. Size: Creations, manipulations, and areas of effect can have up to 1m in diameter, length, width, or height per Animal Handling level. Disperse Insects: If any of your creations with this power are attacked, you can spend a move action and make a Read Movement check as a defensive action. If successful, you disperse the insects seconds before they are attacked, preventing them from being destroyed. You can immediately return the insects to your body as a free action or leave them in the same location. Allowed Effects: Cannon, Orb, Ray, Barrier, Arrows, Ricochet, Column, Cloud, Destructive Breath, Missile. The Kikai Ninpou power also possesses the following unique effect.

The character is able to manipulate microscopic insects. extremely poisonous. Prerequisites: Handling Animals 12; Kikaichuu.
Benefit: Rinkaichuu are insects of almost microscopic size capable of destroying the cells of their enemy, causing immense pain in the process. Because they are so small, each group of rinkaichuu contains thousands of insects. The Aburame clan's clothing prevents the rinkaichuu from leaving their bodies, and users of these insects typically wear gloves and full attire until combat, at which point they remove their clothing, revealing their purple skin covered in insects. Once they leave the host's body, the rinkaichuu will circumvent any clothing worn by the target until they reach their skin. KIDAICHUU NC 12 FORM (EXAMPLE) Attributes Des For Per Int Vig Esp Agi Combat Skills CC LM CD ESQ +9 Statistics Vitality: 24 Chakra: equal to drained chakra Displacement: 15 m; Attack - Bite: CC type; Base Damage 5; Drained Chakra 2 Quantity: The character can keep 1 group of rinkaichuu on their body for each level in Animal Handling. This number is in addition to any other type of insect the character possesses. When any amount of rinkaichuu is lost or transferred (see below), they begin to multiply rapidly, and you recover up to half of the total after 1 turn. Usage: Unlike kikaichuu, which are capable of flying towards the enemy, poisonous insects can only be transferred to a victim's body through direct physical contact between the host's skin and any part of the target's body. Normally the insects are concentrated on the Aburame's torso, but as soon as the fight begins, he can spread them throughout his body as a reaction. With quick contact, such as a touch, the Aburame can only transfer 1 single group of rinkaichuu between itself and the target (and vice versa). You can attack with Multiple Attack and transfer 1 rinkaichuu with each successful attack. If you manage to hold the enemy or maintain contact for an entire turn, you can transfer any number of insects. The transfer of the Aburame's rinkaichuu to the target is not voluntary. Whenever you are touched, the rinkaichuu will immediately transfer to the creature that touched you. Cellular Destruction: Upon reaching the victim, the rinkaichuu act like viruses, multiplying rapidly on the skin. The victim will suffer fixed damage per turn equal to 1 for each rinkaichuu that has infected them. Due to the great pain suffered, the victim must also pass a Stamina test (Difficulty 7 + Animal Handling) to avoid being stunned . For one turn, the insect is fatigued until treated. The test must be repeated whenever the target is contaminated by more insects. The fatigued condition is only cumulative with other conditions of different origins. If Vitality reaches zero, the damage from cellular destruction cannot be reduced below this level; however, the victim becomes paralyzed and will not be able to recover their Vitality until all the insects are removed from their body. Treatment: There are 2 ways to treat a victim infected by rinkaichuu. The first is for the Aburame owner of the insects to remove them himself, touching the victim for one turn. The second method involves clinically analyzing the victim and creating a remedy to combat the insects. Doing so requires Medicine and Occultism 14 (reduced to 12 if the character is from Konoha). Creating the remedy follows the same rules as the poison-making test (see Poisoning, p. 46). Once the remedy is made, it must be taken by the victim for three days until all the insects inside the body die. Natural Antibodies: The rinkaichuu help your body fight off illnesses caused by viruses and bacteria. You receive the benefits of the Enhanced Endurance (Vigor) fitness level in tests of these situations. Restriction: The character cannot possess both the Kidaichuu and Rinkaichuu abilities simultaneously.

Restricted Technique The Akimichi clan can store chakra in their bodies, transforming it into calories for later use when needed. The more calories burned, the greater the benefits received. However, burning a large amount of chakra can lead to significant energy consumption. Consuming a large amount of calories at once or exceeding the limit poses a significant health risk.
Prerequisite: Stamina 14; Body type; Resilience (skills) Usage: Calorie burning has three levels of use: Level 1 (Green), Level 2 (Yellow), and Level 3 (Red). Even if the character does not meet the Stamina prerequisite, they can still use calorie burning by consuming the special colored pills of the Akimichi clan. Doing so, however, is detrimental to the body (see below). Action: Using any level of calorie burning is a partial action. However, due to physical strain, each level can only be used once per scene. Furthermore, if you use a higher level, you cannot use a lower level later (i.e., if you use level 2, you cannot use level 1 afterwards). Cost: Using calorie control costs Vitality points that depend on the level used. Benefits: You receive a certain amount of chakra and a Strength bonus. The chakra bonus is cumulative across levels, lasts for one scene, and cannot exceed your maximum reserve (any excess points will be lost). Duration: Calorie control has a sustained duration. However, using it via colored pills reduces the duration to continuous for 3 days. shifts. Penalties: If you used calorie control via the colored pills, at the end of the last turn of the duration you will suffer the penalties described in each level's description. Recovering Calories: To recover lost calories, a full week of a high-calorie diet is necessary. During this time, if you used level 3 of calorie burning, you lose the benefits of the Resilience fitness level (but retain the penalties). LEVEL 1 – GREEN Benefits: The character loses 3 points of Vitality, receives 6 chakra points and +2 Strength. Penalties: Fatigued for 1 round. LEVEL 2 – YELLOW Benefits: The character loses 5 points of Vitality, receives 10 chakra points and +4 Strength. Penalties: Exhausted for 2 turns. LEVEL 3 – RED Benefits: The character loses 7 Vitality points, receives 14 chakra points and +6 Strength. You enter Chou Mode. Chou Mode: The large amount of chakra released at once causes energy wings to sprout from your back. You no longer suffer the penalties of the Resilience skill. If you are not under the effect of the Baika no Jutsu's size increase, you can replace your Agility with double your level in the Baika Ninpou power for movement calculations and Feint tests. Penalties: Unconscious for 24 hours, unless you pass a Stamina test, difficulty 23, to be merely exhausted for the same amount of time.

This is the advanced bloodline of the Hyuuga clan, known throughout the world for its great perception and power. When the user is utilizing the Byakugan, the nerves around the eyes become more prominent under the skin, making any handsome face quite intimidating. Prerequisites: Perception 1
Benefit: Activating the Byakugan requires a partial action and 1 chakra point. The doujutsu has a continuous duration for one scene and can be activated during defense. While the Byakugan is active, the character gains the following benefits. Super Vision: The user gains 360° X-ray vision, being able to see through any matter and any level of cover. The Hyuuga is not affected by penalties from partial or total camouflage (see page 272), as long as they are environmental camouflages (i.e., penalties of the type caused by mental illusions or blindness still remain). You also gain Chakra Vision and Vision Through the Chakra, as well as the ability to clearly see the chakra circulatory system of any person and identify possible anomalies. Thanks to this, while the Byakugan is active, the Hyuuga cannot suffer surprise attacks or be flanked. Furthermore, once per scene and as a free action, they can simulate 2 dice in any Perception, Search, Alertness, and Tracking check where they can use their vision, even under pressure. Range: The Byakugan extends the character's field of vision. The standard range is 10m + 2m per level in the Track skill. Extended Range: [requires Track 5] The user can double their standard range. First, you initiate concentration by performing hand seals. From the next turn onward, your standard range will be doubled as long as you maintain concentration. Chakra Vision: The character is able to distinguish chakra by color, allowing them to identify when an opponent uses a jutsu, no matter how hidden it may be. Chakra vision also allows them to identify if a person is trapped in a genjutsu, or if a jutsu is affecting a specific area or creature. Vision Through Chakra: The character sees through chakra, and their vision cannot be hidden or deceived by techniques. You are even able to see through chakra creations, such as the Mist (Suiton) effect. Measuring Power: Viewing a creature's chakra allows the user to gauge its approximate strength, or in other words, the approximate level of its character sheet. Distinguish Chakra: The character becomes able to differentiate each creature by its chakra signature. Emotion Analysis: The Byakugan's ability also extends to analyzing people's emotions through chakra fluctuations, heart rate, and breathing, being able to tell, for example, when a person is lying, whether they are happy or sad, whether they are friendly or hostile.

This is a powerful doujutsu exclusive to the Uchiha clan. The Sharingan can manifest in the user during a major battle where their visual perception skills are highly needed. At this level, the Sharingan has an incomplete appearance, with a black comma at the edge of the red iris. The Sharingan grants the Uchiha an enhanced perception of movement, similar to slow-motion vision, allowing them to perfectly predict physical attacks or even ninjutsu.
Prerequisite: Perception 3
Benefit: Activating the Sharingan requires a partial action and 1 chakra point. The doujutsu has a continuous duration for one scene and can be activated during defense. While the Sharingan is active, the character gains the following benefits. Chakra Vision: The character is able to distinguish chakra by color, allowing them to identify when an opponent uses a jutsu, no matter how hidden it may be. Chakra vision also allows them to identify if a person is trapped in a genjutsu, or if a jutsu is affecting a specific area or creature. You are not able to see through chakra creations, such as the Mist Release (Suiton) effect, nor through cover or camouflage. Measuring Power: Viewing a creature's chakra allows the user to gauge its approximate strength, or in other words, the approximate level of its power level. character. Distinguish Chakra: The character becomes able to differentiate each creature by its chakra signature. Perceptive Dodge: The user can use the Read Movement skill to dodge, replacing the Dodge skill in calculating the attacker's hit difficulty. Thus, the attacker's Difficulty will be 9 + the Uchiha's LM accuracy. All the rules, benefits, and penalties for evasion still apply. This means the Uchiha can apply any dodge bonus to their defense using Accelerated Vision (such as from the Reflexes skill). Conversely, they cannot use accuracy bonuses in LM (such as from the Intuition skill).

Nullify Technique: You are able to use the Nullify Technique prediction maneuver (page 267) even if you do not possess an appropriate counter technique in your repertoire, copying the one used by your opponent instead, and paying the same chakra cost. Copy Technique: You are able to temporarily copy and learn a technique that has been nullified or analyzed with your Sharingan. Analyzing a technique during combat is a full action and does not require tests. When the technique is used, you must announce that you will study it, immediately spending your full action. This can be done during any character's turn. You can reuse the copied technique as many times as you want throughout the week, but you will only be able to copy a total of one technique for every 4 full Intelligence points (maximum of 5). If you reach the limit, to copy a new technique, you must forget any old one. The copied technique retains all the parameters that were used at the time of the copy: damage rule, chakra cost, action, duration, etc. These values cannot be modified by the character unless the technique's own rules allow it. Technique bonuses originating from restricted skills or powers cannot be copied. Memorize Technique: You memorize a technique that has been copied. The memorized technique is no longer counted towards the limit of copied techniques and is not forgotten after one week. It is only possible to memorize one technique at a time, but you can choose to memorize a new one whenever you want, forgetting the old one. Optionally, you can learn the technique permanently by paying 2 power points. The technique must be noted on the character sheet as an aptitude. Memorized techniques cannot be used as prerequisites for other techniques, powers, and aptitudes. For characters initially created at CL 8 or higher, the Game Master may allow them to begin the campaign with 1 memorized technique and any number of permanent techniques. Restrictions: Sharingan Mimicry allows you to copy the following types of techniques: a power effect (e.g., Destructive Breath), a shinobi skill (e.g., Clone), or a maneuver skill (e.g., Sweep). It also allows you to copy Level 1 of any common power (e.g., Rasengan 1 and Hachimon 1). If it is a technique of a skill with evolutions (e.g., Shunjutsu) or a Ninpou/Element effect, you copy it at the lowest possible level. You can only use Sharingan Mimicry for techniques that are not from a Secret Technique or Clan, that are within your character's Power Limit, and for which you meet all the prerequisites (such as another power or aptitude, Attribute level, Skill, or Combat Ability). While in control of another's body, the character is still able to communicate with the victim's mind, who remains conscious, although without any control over their body. Target: This technique should only be used on a target that is restrained, grabbed, stunned, defenseless , or surprised (unaware of a surprise attack). Using it on any target outside of these conditions is still possible, but very dangerous, as any minimal movement of the target is enough to miss the transmission of your mind to them. They are also entitled to this test). If it is successful, the Shintenshin no Jutsu fails and your mind is lost until the next turn, leaving you unconscious. In espionage, it's common to use this technique on an animal, such as a falcon for aerial reconnaissance, or a cat to enter places without arousing suspicion. It's not possible to swap minds with a clone. Test: You do not perform tests to use this technique. Upon being hit, the victim's body will be under the user's complete control for 1 round. After that, on their 2nd turn under control, the victim will be entitled to an Intelligence test. If successful, they will regain control and expel the user. If they fail, they will remain under control for the duration of the technique. Unconscious targets only perform the resistance test when they awaken. Irrational animals and henchmen are not entitled to resistance tests against the control. If successful, the victim will regain control of their body for one second, leaving the user stunned. If, due to several such actions, the victim passes three resistance tests (consecutive or not), the technique is canceled. The technique also cancels itself automatically if the user attempts any suicidal action. The cancellation occurs immediately before the action begins. Action, preventing suicide from occurring. You can understand suicide as any action that could cause instant death, such as jumping off a cliff, allowing oneself to suffer a Mercy Blow, or reducing Vitality to zero points or less. The Game Master should handle such situations with care and consistency, possibly requiring the player to have Medicine levels and the Medical Ninja skill to treat corpses, or Mechanism levels and the Engineer skill to create humanoids.
